complete_saved_evidence_audit: All seven original inputs passed the experiment audit via the completed comparison CLI. This independent pass reopens raw rows and stored identities/receipts and does not rerun model execution.

accounting.boundary: Complete cache_diagnostics values compared, including candidate H2D/D2H, selection/residency counts and per-layer records. PyTorch allocated/reserved and device occupancy are separate observations, not cache-budget equality.

original_noise.interpretation: Repeat range and median absolute deviation are empirical detection floors for this exact frozen source, workload, device, affinity and measurement boundary. They are not a permitted regression percentage. A stable migration increase requires investigation even when small; compare paired same-GPU migrated runs and preserve all samples. Three runs do not establish a tail-latency distribution.
original_noise.boundary: Four 16-user/two-round C10 source-input-replay DeepSeek H65536/A128/C1024/P65536/NH16777216 fixed-pool graph traces; all candidate hidden and last-token LM head, independent check01 receipt. No full-output copies or profiler in bench. Sampled allocated/reserved/device-used are distinct; no NH-fill capacity claim.

monitor.boundary: Each sample is checked against its own run UTC interval and process tree; other-GPU compute would count as foreign. Discrete process polling does not capture CPU activity/clocks/utilization or exclude short unsampled activity.

limitations: Historical published data use their original placement and combined-check timing context, not a matched performance control.
Three independent repeats establish empirical ranges and MAD only, not statistical confidence intervals, a tolerated regression percentage, causality or tail behavior.
Correctness/charge equality does not erase latency differences; device used boundary samples are not device or process peaks.
This phase audit cannot prove absence of every unexpected device sync; the separately planned main profile must inspect execution/synchronization/API reasonableness.
